metadata.title: Scenara Urban Evidence Knowledge Catalog
metadata.description: Configurable observation, confidence, review, temporal, and provenance policies for multimodal field-scene intelligence.
metadata.disclaimer: Advisory operational catalog. It does not assert legal compliance and must be paired with local standards and qualified review.

rules.summary: Temporary curb barrier detection using the balanced policy in single capture mode. Balances recall and reviewer workload for routine field operations.
promptInstructions: Identify temporary curb barrier only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Treat the capture as a point-in-time observation without inventing history.
Suppress weak candidates that lack distinguishing evidence.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Concise visible condition grounded in the source evidence.

fields.label: Location hint
fields.description: Stable relative location within the scene without inferring an address.

fields.label: Occlusion
fields.description: How much of the subject is visually obscured.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.description: Lighting context affecting visual confidence.

fields.label: Estimated extent
fields.description: Conservative visual estimate with an explicit unit where possible.

fields.label: Material
fields.description: Observed material for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Observed color for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Blocks Path
fields.description: Observed blocks path for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Ownership Marking
fields.description: Observed ownership marking for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

reviewerQuestions: Does the evidence visibly support the label “Temporary curb barrier”?
Is the marked region or timestamp attached to the correct physical subject?
Could perspective, lighting, occlusion, or a listed exclusion explain the appearance?
Is the point-in-time condition described without implying an unobserved change?

meaningfulChangeWhen: severity increases by at least one band
a previously clear public route becomes obstructed
the subject appears, disappears, or moves beyond the configured spatial tolerance
a required safety or accessibility attribute changes materially

severityBands.when: The condition is visible but does not presently restrict a route or create an immediate hazard.
severityBands.rationale: Record for condition history and routine maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition reduces usability, visibility, or resilience but an adequate alternative remains.
severityBands.rationale: Prioritize for planned inspection or maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition materially restricts access, creates a credible injury risk, or threatens critical function.
severityBands.rationale: Requires prompt human review and response planning.

severityBands.when: The evidence suggests immediate danger, emergency-access loss, major fall/electrical exposure, or active hazardous discharge.
severityBands.rationale: Escalate immediately while preserving uncertainty and evidence.

recommendedActions: Confirm ownership and restore the intended clear route.
Verify the finding in context before any enforcement or irreversible action.
Preserve the original media and record the reviewer decision in the provenance chain.
evidenceRequirements: At least one source asset with an immutable fingerprint.
A normalized region, frame timestamp, or transcript segment binding.
Capture time and scene identity.
Model name, policy rule, and confidence score.
provenanceRequirements: Parent link for every derived or generated output
rules.advisoryNotice: This rule is an operational evidence aid, not a legal code determination. Validate measurements and jurisdiction-specific requirements independently.

severityBands.rationale: Prioritize for planned inspection or maintenance.

severityBands.rationale: Escalate immediately while preserving uncertainty and evidence.

rules.summary: Clear path narrowing detection using the rapid screen policy in single capture mode. Surfaces broad candidates for a fast first-pass field screen.
promptInstructions: Identify clear path narrowing only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Treat the capture as a point-in-time observation without inventing history.
Prefer a reviewable candidate over silent omission when a plausible high-consequence condition is visible.

fields.label: Location hint
fields.description: Stable relative location within the scene without inferring an address.

fields.label: Occlusion
fields.description: How much of the subject is visually obscured.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.description: Lighting context affecting visual confidence.

fields.label: Estimated extent
fields.description: Conservative visual estimate with an explicit unit where possible.

fields.label: Area M2
fields.description: Observed area m2 for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Estimated Depth Mm
fields.description: Observed estimated depth mm for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Blocks Route
fields.description: Observed blocks route for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Likely Source
fields.description: Observed likely source for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

reviewerQuestions: Does the evidence visibly support the label “Standing water”?
Is the marked region or timestamp attached to the correct physical subject?
Could perspective, lighting, occlusion, or a listed exclusion explain the appearance?
Are the compared observations linked to the same persistent entity?

meaningfulChangeWhen: severity increases by at least one band
a previously clear public route becomes obstructed
the subject appears, disappears, or moves beyond the configured spatial tolerance
a required safety or accessibility attribute changes materially

severityBands.when: The condition is visible but does not presently restrict a route or create an immediate hazard.
severityBands.rationale: Record for condition history and routine maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition reduces usability, visibility, or resilience but an adequate alternative remains.
severityBands.rationale: Prioritize for planned inspection or maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition materially restricts access, creates a credible injury risk, or threatens critical function.
severityBands.rationale: Requires prompt human review and response planning.

severityBands.when: The evidence suggests immediate danger, emergency-access loss, major fall/electrical exposure, or active hazardous discharge.
severityBands.rationale: Escalate immediately while preserving uncertainty and evidence.

recommendedActions: Inspect drainage inlets and restore positive drainage.
Verify the finding in context before any enforcement or irreversible action.
Preserve the original media and record the reviewer decision in the provenance chain.
evidenceRequirements: At least one source asset with an immutable fingerprint.
A normalized region, frame timestamp, or transcript segment binding.
Capture time and scene identity.
Model name, policy rule, and confidence score.
provenanceRequirements: Parent link for every derived or generated output
rules.advisoryNotice: This rule is an operational evidence aid, not a legal code determination. Validate measurements and jurisdiction-specific requirements independently.

rules.summary: Standing water detection using the high precision policy in single capture mode. Returns fewer findings with stronger visual and temporal support.
promptInstructions: Identify standing water only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Treat the capture as a point-in-time observation without inventing history.
Suppress weak candidates that lack distinguishing evidence.

promptInstructions: Identify damaged traffic sign only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Treat the capture as a point-in-time observation without inventing history.
Prefer a reviewable candidate over silent omission when a plausible high-consequence condition is visible.

rules.summary: Guardrail protection gap detection using the risk sensitive policy in change detection mode. Prioritizes human oversight when missed hazards have high consequences.
promptInstructions: Identify guardrail protection gap only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Compare stable scene entities across captures before assigning a change kind.
Prefer a reviewable candidate over silent omission when a plausible high-consequence condition is visible.

Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Compare stable scene entities across captures before assigning a change kind.
Suppress weak candidates that lack distinguishing evidence.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Concise visible condition grounded in the source evidence.

fields.label: Location hint
fields.description: Stable relative location within the scene without inferring an address.

fields.label: Occlusion
fields.description: How much of the subject is visually obscured.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.description: Lighting context affecting visual confidence.

fields.label: Estimated extent
fields.description: Conservative visual estimate with an explicit unit where possible.

fields.label: Damage Type
fields.description: Observed damage type for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Lean Deg
fields.description: Observed lean deg for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.description: Observed sharp edge for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Base Exposed
fields.description: Observed base exposed for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

reviewerQuestions: Does the evidence visibly support the label “Damaged bollard”?
Is the marked region or timestamp attached to the correct physical subject?
Could perspective, lighting, occlusion, or a listed exclusion explain the appearance?
Are the compared observations linked to the same persistent entity?

meaningfulChangeWhen: severity increases by at least one band
a previously clear public route becomes obstructed
the subject appears, disappears, or moves beyond the configured spatial tolerance
a required safety or accessibility attribute changes materially

severityBands.when: The condition is visible but does not presently restrict a route or create an immediate hazard.
severityBands.rationale: Record for condition history and routine maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition reduces usability, visibility, or resilience but an adequate alternative remains.
severityBands.rationale: Prioritize for planned inspection or maintenance.

severityBands.when: The condition materially restricts access, creates a credible injury risk, or threatens critical function.
severityBands.rationale: Requires prompt human review and response planning.

severityBands.when: The evidence suggests immediate danger, emergency-access loss, major fall/electrical exposure, or active hazardous discharge.
severityBands.rationale: Escalate immediately while preserving uncertainty and evidence.

recommendedActions: Repair the bollard and check for hidden anchorage damage.
Verify the finding in context before any enforcement or irreversible action.
Preserve the original media and record the reviewer decision in the provenance chain.
evidenceRequirements: At least one source asset with an immutable fingerprint.
A normalized region, frame timestamp, or transcript segment binding.
Capture time and scene identity.
Model name, policy rule, and confidence score.
provenanceRequirements: Parent link for every derived or generated output
rules.advisoryNotice: This rule is an operational evidence aid, not a legal code determination. Validate measurements and jurisdiction-specific requirements independently.

rules.summary: Persistent noise source detection using the rapid screen policy in change detection mode. Surfaces broad candidates for a fast first-pass field screen.
promptInstructions: Identify persistent noise source only when at least one positive visual cue is visible.
Ground every assertion in an evidence region or timestamp and state uncertainty explicitly.
Do not infer legal compliance, ownership, intent, identity, or measurements that are not visibly supported.
Compare stable scene entities across captures before assigning a change kind.
Suppress weak candidates that lack distinguishing evidence.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Concise visible condition grounded in the source evidence.

fields.label: Location hint
fields.description: Stable relative location within the scene without inferring an address.

fields.label: Occlusion
fields.description: How much of the subject is visually obscured.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.description: Lighting context affecting visual confidence.

fields.label: Estimated extent
fields.description: Conservative visual estimate with an explicit unit where possible.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Observed source for this concept; use null rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

reviewerQuestions: Does the evidence visibly support the label “Persistent noise source”?
Is the marked region or timestamp attached to the correct physical subject?
Could perspective, lighting, occlusion, or a listed exclusion explain the appearance?
Are the compared observations linked to the same persistent entity?

meaningfulChangeWhen: severity increases by at least one band

the subject appears, disappears, or moves beyond the configured spatial tolerance
a required safety or accessibility attribute changes materially
